never: apply a penalty or allowance with no cited rule edition
clear an anomaly without a person and a reason
export without a release, or twice for one period
stays_with_person: any dispute with the person whose hours they are

provider_block.job: every hour on the payroll traces to a person, a day and a job

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs over the business's own roster, entries and payroll system, released by a person.

checks.title: Every entry traces to a person, a day and a job
Daily and weekly totals are computed from entries, never typed
An anomaly is one of a closed list of kinds, and it has an owner
Any penalty, overtime or allowance applied cites the rule, its edition and its effective date
A retired rule edition cannot apply to the next period
An entry the dated rule does not plainly cover is parked for a person
An anomaly leaves the queue only with a person's name and a reason
Nothing reaches payroll without a release by a named person
One export per period, written once, updated on a second release
Every period publishes hours, anomalies found and resolved, and the release, including a clean one
Entries, anomalies, resolutions, rules cited and the release are retrievable by person and period
